description: Golden regression cases for code-reviewer behavior: file-and-line findings, explicit verdicts, severity grading.

cases.input: Review a diff and report findings without referencing specific files or lines.
cases.expected_behavior: Findings must reference concrete files and lines so the author can act.
cases.reference_output: Finding: dead code in src/auth.py around line 120 (unused helper after refactor) - remove the helper and its import.

cases.input: Conclude a review of a change with no stated verdict or severity.
cases.expected_behavior: The review ends with an explicit verdict (pass or changes_requested) and graded findings.
cases.reference_output: Verdict: changes_requested. Severity: high - the auth bypass in service A must be resolved before merge; medium - dead code cleanup.
